description: The NRC computer codes page lists the codes the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission uses to model and evaluate fuel behaviour, reactor kinetics, thermal-hydraulic conditions, severe accident progression, time-dependent dose, emergency preparedness and response, health effects, radionuclide transport and materials performance, and whose results support risk-informed decisions and audit calculations. Categories include probabilistic risk assessment (SAPHIRE), fuel behaviour (FRAPCON-3, FRAPTRAN), reactor kinetics (PARCS, coupled to RELAP5), thermal-hydraulics (TRACE as the flagship tool for loss-of-coolant accidents and transients, RELAP5 being phased out, the SNAP interface, and legacy TRAC-P, TRAC-B and CONTAIN), severe accident codes (MELCOR and the MACCS suite with its user interface and pre-processors) and radiological protection codes including RASCAL for rapid assessment of an incident and the RAMP user group. Coverage is generic light-water reactor plants. Access: descriptions on the NRC site and an Obtaining the Codes page; the NRC provides the latest thermal-hydraulic codes to international partners under agreements. Caveats: source availability and licence terms were not stated on the page read. It suits nuclear accident progression and consequence simulation, and relates to the OpenPRA platform catalogued here.
